checks: Eight SVG instruments initialize with the exact character-sheet values and use a local generated panorama

The KI-13 is removed, all panels fit without overlap, both mode controls are metal toggle switches, and real mouse drags plus keyboard controls move the health/luck throttle levers and synchronize values, damage cells and the critical lamp
The kneeboard keeps its size and ten visible rows; plus adds exactly one skill up to 25, scrolls internally, disables at the limit, and retains 0–5 bonuses
All five aircraft nodes match the PDF hit ranges; clicks subtract one STR, zero shows the failure state, the next click fully restores, and nodes track damage independently
Each aircraft node has an independent 1–10 maximum; full nodes follow new maxima, damage is preserved, and armor adds a separate blue bar only above zero
The three-digit afterburner odometer supports up to 999 charges, animates 100→099 and 010→009 correctly, and spends/refills without going negative
Equipment starts with three supplied modules, plus adds one row at a time up to the default capacity of ten, and occupied slots remain independent of character stats
Real mouse drags rotate the needles above the scale, snap to the matching number and persist
Lost HP fills red cells from bottom to top: half HP = 5 red, one quarter = 8
The large central red pilot lamp switches on at exactly 2 HP and below, and stays off at 3 HP even with a 10 HP maximum
HP = vitality × 2 and luck maximum = luck; spent resources stay spent and clamp to the new maximum
Keyboard slider controls and limits work
Holding the stick turns the heading horizontally through 360°, shifts the painted world around a circular panorama and limits bank to 9°; releasing and leveling preserve the selected course and stats
Animated 1–5 D10 rolls show values 1–10 and the exact sum; repeated clicks are blocked, closing mid-roll keeps the result, reduced motion works and five rolls remain in history
Added skill rows, even blank equipment rows, individual STR maxima, armor and three-digit afterburner values survive reloading
Pilot editing, drawer, Cyrillic, callsign plate and all saved values survive reload
The central nameplate opens an accessible editor; cancel preserves the name and save synchronizes the plate, logbook and browser storage
The editable aircraft slot capacity supports more than ten slots, enforces the chosen limit, and preserves all added rows and equipment when lowered and reloaded
The idle monitor shows the top-down aircraft; hovering a gauge temporarily shows its stat, and each of the five synchronized nodes turns green, yellow, then red at 1 STR and remains red at zero
The leather pocket opens the readable flight manual with lore, resource rules and all five D10 hit locations

The propeller hub and turning blades are visible in the cleared forward window: screenshot pixels change during rotation, stay identical when stopped, and the explicit animation switch persists and works with reduced motion enabled

Six 60-degree sectors include imperial cities, clear sky, storm, sea, runway and hangar with mechanics; sunlight and moonlight stay in the distant background and the four-ring iron sight matches the photo on the central axis
Night lighting changes the sky, clouds and cockpit materials without an overlay; gauges and displays glow, controls work, and the mode survives reload and restores cleanly to daylight
390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow; logbook remains usable
Local file opening works offline with no server and no external assets
No JavaScript or SVG rendering errors
browser: Chrome headless, native CDP, temporary profile; no Playwright
